items.title: George Justin Interview, 1958-06-01
items.q: He used to be a wonderful trumpet man. And of course he played on the old style along with the old fellas, like Mania Perez and that bunch.

ctx.x: Old Man Shalini they used to call him. He used to be a wonderful trumpet man. And of course he played on the old style along with the old fellas, like Mania Perez and that bunch. What did you study with him? I studied clarinet. I studied clarinet, the old Albert system under him.
How did he teach? Did he make you learn self-edged and ear training and sight singing first, or started you right on the instrument?
